gloss: to apologize (polite); to offer one's apologies

definitions.explanation: A polite humble verb for offering an apology, especially in business, customer service, and formal correspondence. The honorific お + {詫|わ}び + する pattern makes it more formal than {謝|あやま}る.

examples.japanese: {心|こころ}からお{詫|わ}びします。
ご{迷惑|めいわく}をおかけしたことをお{詫|わ}びいたします。
examples.english: I apologize for the inconvenience caused.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{件|けん}につきまして、{弊社|へいしゃ}を{代表|だいひょう}してお{詫|わ}び{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: Regarding this matter, I would like to apologize on behalf of our company.

notes:
Built from the noun {詫|わ}び (apology) with the honorific お prefix and the light verb する. The more humble form お{詫|わ}びいたします and the very formal お{詫|わ}び{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます are standard in business and written apologies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心|こころ}からお{詫|わ}びする: to apologize sincerely
- {深|ふか}くお{詫|わ}びする: to deeply apologize
- ～についてお{詫|わ}びする: to apologize regarding ～
- お{詫|わ}び{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます: I offer my apologies (most formal)

REGISTER LADDER (least to most polite):
- {謝|あやま}る: to apologize (neutral, everyday)
- {詫|わ}びる: to apologize (slightly more formal, often written)
- お{詫|わ}びする: to apologize (polite humble form)
- お{詫|わ}びいたします / お{詫|わ}び{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます: most formal, business/written

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {謝罪|しゃざい}する: to apologize (formal, often public/official)
- すみません: a casual apology phrase
